source.title: Keystone metro cost factor (BLS OEWS wages, see README cost method)

factor.note: MSA 26420 Houston-Pasadena-The Woodlands, TX: labour index L=0.89, materials M=1.0. 5/5 trades (OEWS May 2024 via O*NET Texas local-wages search extracts). Ratios to US: 47-2031 0.825; 47-2111 0.949; 47-2152 0.956; 47-2061 0.824; 49-9021 0.968. L = 0.89; factor = 0.40*0.89 + 0.60*1.00 = 0.96. M=1.00 (default, no public citable reason to adjust).

cost.method: Factor = 0.40*L + 0.60*M, rounded to 2 decimals. L = weighted mean of (metro annual median wage / US national annual median wage) for SOC 47-2031 Carpenters (0.30), 47-2111 Electricians (0.20), 47-2152 Plumbers/Pipefitters/Steamfitters (0.20), 47-2061 Construction Laborers (0.20), 49-9021 HVAC Mechanics/Installers (0.10), from BLS OEWS; weights renormalised over occupations available for the MSA. M = materials index, 1.00 for all Texas metros (no public citable reason to adjust); qualitative materials notes per MSA. Wave 2 (2026-10-11): all five trades retrieved from O*NET Texas local-wages pages (OEWS May 2024) via search extracts (Secondary); HVAC missing for 28660, 47380, 46340, 17780 (weights renormalised there). provisional removed for every MSA with >=4 trades.

plainLanguage: Sugar Land is ahead of most Texas cities: for permit applications from January 21, 2026 it uses the 2024 International codes (including the 2024 IRC) and the 2023 electrical code, with local changes in Ordinance 2395. In the standard R-1 single-family zone, lots are at least 6,600 sq ft and 60 ft wide; plan on a 25-ft front setback, 5-ft side yards, a 15-ft rear yard, up to 35 ft or 2.5 stories, and about 40% lot coverage. Many neighborhoods are planned developments with their own rules, so check your PD ordinance and HOA. Sugar Land is not in the state windstorm area. The permit fee is set by square footage, plus a plan-check fee of half the permit fee; we estimate about $2,700 for a 2,400 sq ft house with garage. Water and sewer connection fees are about $1,100.
